%% overwrites this file on every re-vendor; fix it upstream in the
%% scitex-writer package instead.
%% File: 00_shared/latex_styles/pdf_text.tex
%%
%% Copyable, searchable PDF text. Loaded right after \usepackage[T1]{fontenc}.
%%
%% pdfTeX only (XeTeX/LuaTeX use Unicode fonts and need none of this):
%% - T1 text in the default Computer Modern family needs outline EC fonts
%%   (cm-super). Without them pdfTeX embeds bitmap Type3 fonts with no Unicode
%%   map, so a copied "effort" reads "e\x1bort". Latin Modern is the outline
%%   T1 version of the same design; it replaces only the default family, so
%%   a class or project font choice (e.g. times) is kept.
%% - glyphtounicode + \pdfgentounicode map every glyph, ligatures included,
%%   back to Unicode text.
%% - \pdfinterwordspaceon (pdfTeX >= 1.40.15) emits real space glyphs, so
%%   viewers that copy text without guessing word gaps keep the spaces.
\usepackage{iftex}
\ifPDFTeX
  \begingroup
    \edef\x{\rmdefault}\def\y{cmr}%
    \ifx\x\y\endgroup\usepackage{lmodern}\else\endgroup\fi
  \input{glyphtounicode}%
  \pdfgentounicode=1
  \ifdefined\pdfinterwordspaceon\pdfinterwordspaceon\fi
\fi

%%%% EOF
